grammar.1.title: Time and frequency
grammar.1.note: Official time: „achtzehn Uhr“ = 6 p.m. „halb neun“ = half past eight.
grammar.1.rows.1.1: once / twice / three times a week
grammar.1.rows.4.1: in the morning / in the evening
grammar.2.title: Integrationskurs and VHS
grammar.2.text: The Volkshochschule (VHS) offers German courses at low cost in almost every town. The Integrationskurs usually covers the language and an introduction to Germany; who can take part depends on your residence permit (Aufenthaltstitel) — ask BAMF or your local office.
